title: Data Analyst
text:
Data Analyst (1-3 years) - Sample Retail Insights Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru

About us
Sample Retail Insights Pvt Ltd builds reporting for supermarket chains across South India.

Responsibilities
- Write SQL to answer questions from the category team
- Maintain Excel trackers and pivot reports for weekly reviews
- Do data cleaning on raw sales files before analysis
- Build dashboards in Tableau for store managers
- Present findings to business teams

Requirements
- Graduate in any discipline with 1 to 3 years in an analyst role
- Good SQL and Excel
- Comfortable with Tableau
- Basic statistics: averages, variance, correlation

Good to have
- Python for automation
- Experience with Looker Studio
- Knowledge of Tally

Location: Bengaluru, work from office. Notice period: immediate to 30 days.
